text:
Predicates:
Hosted(x, y) ::: x hosted y.
Olympics(y) ::: y is an Olympic event.
Summer(y) ::: y is a summer event.
Winter(y) ::: y is a winter event.
University(x) ::: x is a university.
RankedAmongBest(x) ::: x is ranked among the best universities in the world.
CapitalOf(x, y) ::: x is the capital of y.
LocatedIn(x, y) ::: x is located in y.
Population(y) ::: y is the most populous nation.
"People's Republic of China" ::: the People's Republic of China.
"World" ::: the world.

Premises:
CapitalOf(Beijing, "People's Republic of China") ::: Beijing is the capital of the People's Republic of China.
CapitalOf(Beijing, "world") ::: Beijing is the capital of the world's most populous nation.
LocatedIn(Beijing, NorthernChina) ::: Beijing is located in Northern China.
Hosted(Beijing, "2008 Summer Olympics") ::: Beijing hosted the 2008 Summer Olympics.
Hosted(Beijing, "2008 Summer Paralympics") ::: Beijing hosted the 2008 Summer Paralympics.
Hosted(Beijing, "Summer Olympics") ::: Beijing has hosted the Summer Olympics.
Hosted(Beijing, "Winter Olympics") ::: Beijing has hosted the Winter Olympics.
Hosted(Beijing, "Summer Paralympics") ::: Beijing has hosted the Summer Paralympics.
Hosted(Beijing, "Winter Paralympics") ::: Beijing has hosted the Winter Paralympics.
∀x (University(x) → RankedAmongBest(x)) ::: Many of Beijing's universities consistently rank among the best in the world.
NumberOfUniversitiesInBeijing(91) ::: Many of Beijing's 91 universities.

Conclusion:
Hosted(Beijing, "2008 Summer Olympics") ∧ Hosted(Beijing, "Winter Olympics") ::: Beijing hosted both the 2008 Summer Olympics and the Winter Olympics.
